Proposition
[Co-area formula (Proposition 27.30)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0038 1. ch27:27.30\group Volume growth

For Lipschitz $f$ and integrable (or nonnegative measurable) $h$, $\int h|\nabla f|\, d\mu =\int dc\int _{\{ f=c\} }h\, d\sigma $.
